answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. The key insight is that coordination itself leaks: the more unified a farm is, the more easily its shared style or timing betrays it. The mechanism therefore aligns self-interest with network health: an attacker gains most by behaving honestly, because that is the only move that scales. Consider a anchor as the anchor of the cost.
